## TRA Timeline

#### Caritas business combination announcement

- 2021-09-29: 8-K/A reports Business Combination Agreement with Amicus Therapeutics, Caritas Therapeutics LLC, and Amicus GT Holdings; form-of TRA appears as Exhibit C to the BCA
- 2021-11-01: S-4 / proxy describes the contemplated 85% TRA in narrative form

#### Caritas BCA termination

- 2022-02-23: ARYA and Caritas mutually terminate the BCA; TRA never executed (confirmed via the FY2021 10-K)

#### Post-termination wind-down

- 2024-02-13: ARYA signs Adagio Medical BCA, a conventional C-corp merger with no TRA contemplated
- 2024-08-12: ARYA deregisters (Form 15-12G)

## Explanation

ARYA Sciences Acquisition Corp IV was a SPAC that signed a Business Combination Agreement on September 29, 2021 with Amicus Therapeutics and Caritas Therapeutics LLC contemplating an Up-C structure in which the post-domestication Caritas Therapeutics, Inc. would enter an 85% Tax Receivable Agreement with Amicus GT Holdings and future LLC members covering basis step-ups on future Unit exchanges. The form-of TRA appeared only as Exhibit C inside the BCA exhibit, with a blank preamble date. ARYA and Caritas mutually terminated the BCA on February 23, 2022, foreclosing TRA execution. ARYA subsequently signed a separate February 2024 BCA with Adagio Medical (a conventional C-corp merger with no TRA), closed that transaction in July 2024, and deregistered. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
